name: Kashmir in Autumn Colours
route: Srinagar · Pampore · Pahalgam · Southern springs · Gulmarg
description: City gardens, mountain light, and a gentle seasonal valley circuit.

itinerary.title: A lakeside welcome
itinerary.description: Arrive in Srinagar and allow time to settle in. Plan a gentle afternoon among the Mughal gardens, followed by the Dal Lake waterfront. Request a shikara outing timed around the evening light; garden visits and the boat ride must be listed in your quote.
itinerary.meals: Dinner, if included in your quote

itinerary.title: Across the saffron country
itinerary.description: Follow the valley towards Pahalgam, discussing suitable stops around Pampore and Awantipora. A saffron-farm visit or local lunch can be requested from a participating host. Harvest activity depends on the season and is never guaranteed.
experiences: Seasonal farm visit by prior arrangement
itinerary.meals: Breakfast & dinner proposed; hosted lunch only if confirmed

itinerary.title: A day in the Lidder Valley
itinerary.description: Spend the day around Pahalgam with a route suited to the group. Aru and Betaab are options for valley scenery and short walks. Agree local union-vehicle charges, entry tickets and any pony activity before choosing them; leave room for a slower afternoon.
experiences: Valley walks at your own pace
Optional pony activity with terms agreed first

itinerary.title: The southern spring trail
itinerary.description: Request a southern-valley excursion linking forest scenery and the springs at Kokernag and Verinag. This is a substantial road day, so the final route should reflect daylight, local conditions and the group’s pace. A shorter alternative can replace the full circuit.
experiences: A slower walk around the springs

itinerary.title: Mountain light in Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Head towards Gulmarg for meadow scenery and mountain views. If you want to ride the Gondola, ask for the exact phases, ticket costs and booking arrangements in writing. Operations depend on weather and availability; a lower-level walk is a possible alternative.
experiences: A mountain walk suited to conditions
Optional Gondola ride with confirmed tickets

itinerary.title: Nature and the old city
itinerary.description: Explore a locally approved nature visit at Dachigam if permissions and opening arrangements allow. Later, request a guided walk through Srinagar’s older neighbourhoods, with time for craft lanes, architecture and tea. Wildlife sightings and access to individual buildings are not promised.

itinerary.title: One more valley morning
itinerary.description: Keep your final morning flexible around your flight. A brief lakefront stop or time for shopping may fit before the arranged transfer. Confirm pickup time and allow a generous buffer for traffic and airport procedures.
experiences: Departure transfer at the agreed time
